newsitem.title: UK: Anglian to make international provision - FT.
newsitem.headline: Anglian to make international provision - FT.

text.p: British regional utility Anglian Water Plc is expected to make a charge of 15 million pounds in its annual results next month after a review of its international operations, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
It quoted finance director Chris Mellor as saying revenues from an effluent treatment project in Brazil had started coming in nine months later than expected.
In addition a 3.5 million stg investment in a Czech treatment works had "not gone as well as we would have liked", he said.

According to the report, Mellor said after a divisional presentation to directors on Thursday that it "might be reasonable to expect some provisioning" but he indicated a final decision would be taken when directors meet next month.

Anglian announced in February that it would make a provision of 20 million pounds in its results to pay for a reduction of up to 300 jobs in its production and networks divisions, to cut 10 million stg a year off its annual costs.
